english: Surgery is the only potentially curative treatment available for localized retroperitoneal sarcoma (RPS). Multivisceral en-bloc resection of the tumor surrounded by a cuff of healthy tissues to achieve negative margins all-around has proved to be effective in reducing the risk of local recurrence. english: Cardiovascular disease is a general term for conditions that affect the heart and blood vessels. It is one of the leading causes of death worldwide. english: Meibomian gland dysfunction is the leading cause of dry eye worldwide. Long term use of antiglaucoma medications is one of the main causes for MGD. And there are not much studies on the evaluation of meibomian gland dysfunction in glaucoma patients on long term topical medications. so in this study we are going to look at morphological changes in meibomian glands in patients on long term topical antiglaucoma medications and compare with those patients who are not on any topical medications to see if the deficiency in lipid layer of the tear film that is produced by the meibomian glands, has a role to play in the changes in ocular surface and dry eye in these patients. We will then publish the results in so others can read about it and learn from the results of the study, so that the new-found information may be used to benefit others. The personal information collected will still remain strictly confidential, and only the interpretations of the data will be published.

english: Bone and joint infections are usually treated with surgery and a course of intravenous antibiotics. The current standard of care in the management of multidrug resistant chronic bone and joint infections usually requires a prolonged course (i.e. 4–6 weeks) of intravenous (IV) antibiotics during the early intensive phase treatment. There is little evidence to suggest that oral (PO) therapy results in worse outcomes during the early intensive phase. Therefore, we are conducting a pilot study to address the implications of early oral antimicrobial therapy in the treatment of multidrug resistant chronic bone and joint infections.

english: Informed consent sheet number: _________

You have been asked to participate in this study because you have kidney stones and you have been advised removal of the stones. This will be done by a surgery known as percutaneous nephrolithotomy (PCNL), during which time a small opening is made near the kidney through which a scope will be introduced and the stone removed. For this procedure we will be giving you general anaesthesia. This means that you will be completely sleeping throughout the procedure. This surgery can be done in two positions. Either the stone will be removed with you lying on your back (supine position) or it can be removed with you lying on your tummy (prone position). The best position for the removal of your stone will be decided by your surgeon who is the best judge of this. In this study, we will be comparing and seeing which position is better and observing whether there are any differences between the two positions from the anaesthesia point of view. This study will help us understand and find out which position has lesser complications in which position the patient has better anaesthetic outcomes.

On evaluation of your own HLA, it has been found that you have matching HLA alleles at each of the loci tested – in other words you have inherited identical 50 % HLA alleles from your father and mother. Such individuals are said to have a “ homozygous ” HLA haplotype. Banking cells and their derivatives from such individuals, who are uncommon in the community is being called “ haplobanking ”. We thank you for having volunteered to be a blood donor for the generation of induced pluripotent stem cell ( iPSC ) lines. Our primary goal is to provide cells for patient transplant that have been derived from tissue-type ( HLA ) matched donors which will reduce the need for immunosuppression to prevent tissue rejection. malayalam: നിങ്ങളുടെ സ്വന്തം HLA യുടെ മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയത്തിൽ, പരിശോധിച്ച ഓരോ ലോക്കിയിലും നിങ്ങൾക്ക് യോജിക്കുന്ന HLA അല്ലീലുകൾ ഉണ്ടെന്ന് കണ്ടെത്തി - മറ്റൊരു വിധത്തിൽ പറഞ്ഞാൽ, നിങ്ങളുടെ അച്ഛനിൽ നിന്നും അമ്മയിൽ നിന്നും സമാനമായ 50% HLA അല്ലീലുകൾ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് പാരമ്പര്യമായി ലഭിച്ചു. അത്തരം വ്യക്തികൾക്ക്"ഹോമോസൈഗസ്" HLA ഹാപ്ലോടൈപ്പ് ഉണ്ടെന്ന് പറയപ്പെടുന്നു. സമൂഹത്തിൽ അസാധാരണമായ അത്തരം വ്യക്തികളിൽ നിന്നുള്ള ബാങ്കിംഗ് സെല്ലുകളും അവയുടെ ഡെറിവേറ്റീവുകളും"ഹാപ്ലോബാങ്കിംഗ്" എന്ന് വിളിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു. ഇൻഡ്യൂസ്‌ഡ് പ്ലൂറിപോട്ടന്റ് സ്റ്റെം സെൽ (iPSC) ലൈനുകളുടെ ഉൽപാദനത്തിനായി ഒരു ബ്ലഡ് ഡോണർ ആകാൻ സന്നദ്ധത അറിയിച്ചതിന് ഞങ്ങൾ നിങ്ങളോടു നന്ദി പറയുന്നു. ടിഷ്യു-ടൈപ്പ് (HLA ) യോജിക്കുന്ന ഡോണർമാരിൽ നിന്ന് കിട്ടിയ പേഷ്യന്റ് ട്രാൻസ്പ്ലാൻറിനുള്ള കോശങ്ങൾ നൽകുക എന്നതാണ് ഞങ്ങളുടെ പ്രാഥമിക ലക്ഷ്യം, ഇത് ടിഷ്യു റിജക്ഷൻ തടയുന്നതിനുള്ള ഇമ്മ്യുണോസപ്രഷന്റെ ആവശ്യകത കുറയ്ക്കും. ഇത് ഭാവിയിൽ അവരുടെ സെല്ലുകൾ സമാനമായോ ഭാഗികമായോ യോജിക്കുന്ന HLA അല്ലീലുകൾ പങ്കിടുന്ന കൂടുതൽ ആളുകളെ ചികിത്സിക്കുന്നതിനു ഉപയോഗിക്കാൻ സാധ്യതയുണ്ട്. ഈ ആവശ്യത്തിനാണ് 30 മില്ലി രക്തം ഒറ്റത്തവണ ദാനം ചെയ്യുന്നത് പരിഗണിക്കാൻ നിങ്ങളോട് ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്നത്‌. ഇതിന്റെ പ്രവർത്തന വേളയിൽ, നിങ്ങളുടെ കോശങ്ങൾ മറ്റ് പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട ഗവേഷണ ലക്ഷ്യങ്ങൾക്കു ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നതിനും വിലപ്പെട്ടതാണെന്ന് ഞങ്ങൾ തീരുമാനിച്ചേക്കാമെന്നു ദയവായി ശ്രദ്ധിക്കുക.

english: Ans. In this study, cartilage pieces from child’s own pelvis bone near waist is taken out. Human satellite cells are a special type of cell present in and give rise to the muscle. The main function of the satellite cell is to repair the damaged muscle. Generally, in our normal muscle, the satellite cells are in the resting (dormant) stage and if there is any injury to the muscle, the satellite cells get activated from the rest and undergo cell division. The activated and dividing cells are called myoblasts. The myoblasts undergo further differentiation and form myotubes, which get fused with the damaged muscle and repair the defect. In this study, we are attempting to use the satellite/myoblast cells to repair the damaged urinary sphincter muscle for controlling urine leakage.

english: Glaucoma is the second leading cause of blindness worldwide. Topical antiglaucoma drugs are the standard form of therapy which is usually prescribed for long term use and in multiple dosing. Meibomian Glands, which are present on the undersurface of our eyelids secrete the oily layer of the tear film. Deficiency of this layer causes dry eye. The most common side effect complained by the patients on long term topical antiglaucoma drugs is dry eye. And the cause for dry eye is thought to be meibomian gland dysfunction . Our study aims to compare the degree of meibomian gland dysfunction between cases and controls. This is achieved by measuring the gland area and area of loss by using Sirius topography machine.
